tool.name: Larch Athena
tool.description: process Athena projects of XAFS data

param.name: dat_file
param.label: Athena project
param.help: X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) data, in Athena project format

section.name: processing
section.title: Processing Options
section.help: By default, the following processing steps will be performed either with default values, or those contained in the input Athena project (if used). If specified here, these values will be used instead for process in sequence.

param.name: calibrate
param.label: Calibrate energy
param.help: If set, will shift the spectrum so that its (automatically determined) edge occurs at the specified value, and any values outside the range will be discarded.

param.name: calibration_e0
param.label: Calibration energy (eV)
param.help: If set, data will be calibrated so that the edge occurs at this energy (after merging, if relevant). Note that this is different from specifying E0 in the pre-edge normalization, as this will the x-axis of the data (so that the Nth x point will no longer align with the Nth y point).

param.name: energy_min
param.label: Minimum energy (eV)
param.help: If set, data will be cropped below this value in electron volts (after re-calibrating).

param.name: energy_max
param.label: Maximum energy (eV)
param.help: If set, data will be cropped above this value in electron volts (after re-calibrating).

param.name: rebin
param.label: Re-bin data
param.help: Whether to re-bin along the energy axis to automatically ensure appropriate levels of precision in the pre-edge, near-edge and extended region of the spectrum.

param.name: pre_edge
param.label: Pre-edge normalization
param.help: If set, will (re)perform forward pre-edge normalization using provided values.

param.name: ref_channel
param.label: Reference channel
param.help: The channel to be used as a reference to determine the pre-edge settings which are then used for the main signal. This can help when the main signal is affected by signal noise.

param.label: Edge energy (eV)
param.help: If set, normalization will use this as the location of the edge rather than automatically determining it.

param.label: Pre-edge fit lower energy (eV)
param.help: The lower end of the region used for the pre-edge fitting, relative to the edge energy (and therefore negative).

param.label: Pre-edge fit upper energy (eV)
param.help: The upper end of the region used for the pre-edge fitting, relative to the edge energy (and therefore negative).

param.label: Post-edge fit lower energy (eV)
param.help: The lower end of the region used for the post-edge fitting, relative to the edge energy (and therefore positive).

param.label: Post-edge fit upper energy (eV)
param.help: The upper end of the region used for the post-edge fitting, relative to the edge energy (and therefore positive).

param.label: Post-edge fit polynomial degree
param.help: The degree of the polynomial used to fit in the post-edge region.

param.label: Edge step
param.help: Magnitude of the step in μ between the pre and post-edge regions at the edge energy.

param.label: Energy exponent
param.help: Edge fitting will be performed against μ*E**n where n is defined here. This is 0 by default.

param.name: xftf
param.label: XFTF
param.help: If set, will (re)perform forward Fourier Transform using provided values.
Minimum k value.
Maximum k value.
Exponent for weighting spectra by raising k to this power.
Tapering parameter for Fourier Transform window.
Fourier Transform window type.

tool.help:
Using Larch, process and normalise Athena project files.
Optionally, plot the xμ data along with pre and post edge fitting lines for visual inspection.
